calibration.description: Original 62 answers plus ten new tasks; one selected attempt per task. The original 62 used older instructions and the final ten saw v2 limits. One v2 profile is applied retrospectively. All 72 passed private Docker tests; the final ten exceeded their printed 100,000-total-token ceilings and forfeited positive credit. This is not a fresh official run under one shared set of printed instructions.
calibration.limitation: The score reduction reflects token penalties. Astra still solved every task; this result does not demonstrate lower raw correctness or distinguish models.

publication_override.basis: Maintainer explicitly requested leaderboard publication of this saved calibration result.
